segments.ja437:1.1: Na kho me ruccati āḷi, pūtimaṃsassa pekkhanā;
segments.ja437:2.1: Ummattikā ayaṃ veṇī, vaṇṇeti patino sakhiṃ;
segments.ja437:2.3: Pajjhāyi [pajjhāti (sī. pī.), pajjhāyati (sī. niyya)] paṭigacchantiṃ, āgataṃ meṇḍa [meḷa (sī. pī.)] mātaraṃ.
segments.ja437:3.1: Tvaṃ khosi samma ummatto, dummedho avicakkhaṇo;
segments.ja437:3.3: Yo tvaṃ [so tvaṃ (syā.)] matālayaṃ katvā, akālena vipekkhasi.
segments.ja437:4.1: Na akāle vipekkheyya, kāle pekkheyya paṇḍito;
segments.ja437:4.3: Pūtimaṃsova pajjhāyi [pajjhāti (sī. pī.), pajjhāyati (sī. niyya)], yo akāle vipekkhati.
segments.ja437:5.1: Piyaṃ kho āḷi me hotu, puṇṇapattaṃ dadāhi me;
segments.ja437:5.3: Pati sañjīvito mayhaṃ, eyyāsi piyapucchikā [pucchitā (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja437:6.1: Piyaṃ kho āḷi te hotu, puṇṇapattaṃ dadāmi te;
segments.ja437:6.3: Mahatā parivārena [parihārena (syā.)], essaṃ [esaṃ (sī. pī.)] kayirāhi [kayirāsi (pī.)] bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja437:7.1: Kīdiso tuyhaṃ parivāro, yesaṃ kāhāmi bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja437:7.3: Kiṃnāmakā ca te sabbe, taṃ [te (sī. syā. pī.)] me akkhāhi pucchitā.
segments.ja437:8.1: Māliyo caturakkho ca, piṅgiyo atha jambuko;
segments.ja437:8.3: Ediso mayhaṃ parivāro, tesaṃ kayirāhi [kayirāsi (pī.)] bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja437:9.3: Ārogyaṃ āḷino vajjaṃ [vacchaṃ (?)], idheva vasa māgamāti.
